body.h: In this pattern everyone passes four count. Anne always passes to Ben, Ben always passes to Clare, Clare always passes to Daniel and Daniel always passes to Anne. The jugglers start standing at four of the points of a five point star. Daniel is standing two points clockwise from the empty point, and he starts with two clubs. Everybody else starts with three clubs. Whenever you pass a club, but don't receive one, you end up with two clubs. At this point you stop juggling and walk across the pattern to the empty point of the star, where you will receive your next pass.
Note: the diagram doesn't show the whole pattern. The last diagram is just like the first, except Anne and Daniel have swapped roles, and Ben and Clare's have swapped roles.
If you're feeling brave, you could try a faster version of the shooting star, by passing two count!
